title.narrative: Promo-Lex_Democracy in Action: Strengthening Electoral Integrity

description.narrative: The "Democracy in Action: Strengthening Electoral Integrity, Political Accountability, and Civic Participation" project aims to support Moldovas democratic resilience by ensuring transparent electoral processes, fostering civic engagement, and strengthening key democratic institutions in the context of the countrys EU integration efforts. The project will be implemented from April 2025 to December 2026, with funding from Sweden and UK. The intervention is structured around three key objectives: 1.Enhancing Electoral Integrity Conducting comprehensive election observation missions for the 2025 parliamentary elections, regional elections in Gagauzia, and new/early local elections in 20252026. The project will include monitoring political party financing, election administration, voter accessibility, and electoral disputes to ensure transparency and fairness. 2.Increasing Civic Awareness and Participation Implementing voter education campaigns, Get Out The Vote (GOTV) initiatives, and civic activism programs to encourage informed participation, particularly among youth, diaspora, and marginalized communities. 3.Improving Democratic Governance and Accountability Monitoring parliamentary decision-making, political finance regulations, and the use of administrative resources, while advocating for institutional reforms to promote transparency and fair political competition. The project is implemented by Promo-LEX, a leading Moldovan civil society organization specializing in electoral monitoring, democratic governance, and civic engagement. Key stakeholders include: •Public Authorities Parliament, Central Electoral Commission (CEC), Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Internal Affairs, and oversight bodies such as the Prosecutors Office and Equality Council. •Political Parties & Electoral Contenders Engaging in election monitoring, transparency initiatives, and campaign finance oversight. •Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) & Media Playing a critical role in voter education, election observation, and advocacy efforts. By strengthening electoral integrity, expanding civic engagement, and reinforcing democratic accountability, this intervention will contribute to Moldovas democratic consolidation and align the countrys institutions with European governance standards.

Projektet fokuserar på att skydda valens integritet i de kommande parlaments- och regionalvalen 2025, stärka civilsamhällets deltagande samt säkerställa parlamentarisk tillsyn och rättvis politisk konkurrens. Genom omfattande valövervakning, påverkansarbete för valreformer och riktade insatser för medborgarutbildning syftar projektet till att främja fria och rättvisa val, stärka institutionernas trovärdighet och stödja Moldaviens långsiktiga åtagande för demokratisk styrning inom ramen för EU-integrationsagendan.
Med stöd från Sverige och Storbritannien utgör Democracy in Action-projektet en samlad insats för att stärka Moldaviens demokratiska grundvalar i en tid då landets framtid som en stabil, europeiskt orienterad demokrati är beroende av starka institutioner och aktivt medborgardeltagande.
I Gagauzien lägger projektet särskild vikt vid att öka det civila engagemanget och det inkluderande deltagandet i valprocessen, vilket stärker lokala demokratiska praktiker och bidrar till konfliktförebyggande genom ökat förtroende mellan medborgare, institutioner och valrelaterade aktörer.
Projektet integrerar jämställdhet genom att främja kvinnors deltagande i valprocesser. Det arbetar även med att motverka hatretorik och desinformation genom övervakning, medvetandegörande insatser och kapacitetsstärkande åtgärder för civilsamhälle, medier och offentliga institutioner, med fokus på att motverka skadliga narrativ och främja ett inkluderande och rättighetsbaserat offentligt samtal.

The project focuses on safeguarding electoral integrity in the upcoming 2025 parliamentary and regional elections, strengthening civil society participation, and ensuring parliamentary oversight and fair political competition. Through comprehensive election monitoring, advocacy for electoral reforms, and targeted civic education initiatives, the project seeks to promote free and fair elections, reinforce institutional credibility, and support Moldova’s long-term commitment to democratic governance in the context of its European integration agenda. With support from Sweden, and the UK, the Democracy in Action project it is a comprehensive effort to fortify Moldova’s democratic foundations at a time when the country’s future as a stable, European-aligned democracy depends on the strength of its institutions and the active participation of its citizens. In Gagauzia, the project places particular emphasis on increasing civic engagement and inclusive participation in the electoral process, thereby strengthening local democratic practices and contributing to conflict prevention through improved trust between citizens, institutions, and electoral stakeholders. The project integrates gender equality by promoting women’s participation in electoral processes. It also addresses hate speech and disinformation through monitoring, awareness-raising, and capacity-building for civil society, media, and public institutions, with a focus on countering harmful narratives and promoting inclusive, rights-based discourse.
